text: hey this works now. in the painter can you fix this annoying bug: i add image to trace, i want to move the image, it is spawning some tooltip in the way of the gizmo and i cant move the mf anymore
resolution: Moving a trace-image backdrop was blocked because the gizmo's live drag readout (DragReadout in scene/staging.tsx + the inline gizmoReadout box in StudioViewport) rendered as an absolutely-positioned Box at the gizmo anchor WITHOUT pointerEvents:'none' — so it hit-tested above the viewport Pressable and swallowed the drag; the readout sat on the move arrows and the user couldn't grab them. Every other editor overlay (SelectionOverlay, PaintGridOverlay) is pointer-transparent for this exact reason (meshSelect.tsx documents it). Added pointerEvents:'none' to both readout boxes, and anchored the readout to moveBackdrop.pos while moving a backdrop (its gizmo is the live handle and the model gizmo is hidden then) so it floats by the correct arrows. Cart-only change, hot-reloads, bundle-checked.
